description: The mid-session shape inventory (#149): every committed shape's id, sheet, condition tag, role, quantities, room label, vertex count, and review state in one compact read — the ids edit_shape and delete_shape assume you have, without pulling the whole export_takeoff payload to find one shape. Filter by sheet, by condition, or both; filters narrow, an empty list is a result, not an error.

condition.description: Only shapes under this finish tag (must exist)

name: list_shapes

agent_edits.description: Present when the agent has revised this shape

assignment.description: Where the finish tag came from: "schedule" = resolved from the room's own schedule row, "asserted" = the agent chose it. origin.assignment in export_takeoff carries the citation. Absent on human canvas shapes

height_ft.description: surface_area shapes — the height they were quantified at

label.description: The room (or phase/area) this shape belongs to — detect_rooms stamps the room number it traced from; edit_shape sets or clears it. Absent when unlabeled

proposal_id.description: The propose_takeoff batch this shape was committed under (#365) — present on shapes committed while a proposal was open; an accepted shape keeps it as history

reviewed.description: true = human-affirmed ink, refused by every agent mutation
